name: lookup_zone
description: When the person says they are somewhere other than their enrolled address, look up the zone for that place. Returns the zone and the directive a human approved for it, which you then read verbatim. If no zone is found, you have no instruction for them.

location_text.description: The place in their words: address, intersection or landmark.

execution_message_description: One short sentence in the language of the call saying you are checking the instructions for that place.
